description: A BitBake include file (.inc) for PostgreSQL, defining package metadata, dependencies, configuration, and installation procedures within the OpenEmbedded build framework.

classes.name: inherit
classes.description: Inheritance of bitbake classes providing autotools, pkgconfig, systemd, and other build features.

methods.name: pkg_postinst
methods.description: Post-installation script to enable or mask systemd services based on distro features.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the PostgreSQL build with autotools, applies patches, and sets up Perl environment.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the contrib modules of PostgreSQL.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs PostgreSQL binaries, documentation, init scripts, systemd units, and related files.

methods.name: populate_packages
methods.description: Dynamically populates the list of related packages based on the configuration.
